brief: The canvas reveals a magnified, deep cross-section of interwoven, complex natural pathways, structured like solidified, dripping beeswax. These intricate networks are filled with crystalline veins and sediment deposits, ranging in color from amber gold to muted earth tones. The patterns are highly detailed and appear to follow the logic of ancient folklore and subterranean journeys. The shapes are organic yet geometric, forming interwoven matrices that stabilize in place, creating the illusion of a solid, fossilized tapestry viewed at a lunar scale.

statement: This sketch renders a still, intricate cross-section of fossilized geological formations resembling solidified beeswax. The composition features interwoven organic pathways—represented as flowing threads—that grow and branch within a deep amber-toned landscape. These structures are punctuated by crystalline veins and sediment deposits that create a sense of ancient subterranean journeys. The piece captures the illusion of a stabilized, layered tapestry viewed at an intimate scale, where detail emerges from the complexity of form and color without any animated motion to disrupt its contemplative stillness.
